+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 5 (capstone): a Rian DRIVER owns the whole loop
+# ===========================================================================
+# Rung 4 (selfhost_compose_mod.rian) emitted a whole module's `:compile.forms`
+# input in Rian, but the fixpoint test still *called* `:compile.forms` and
+# `:code.load_binary` itself — the BEAM toolchain entry points lived in Elixir.
+# This rung pulls that final step into Rian: a driver that takes SOURCE and a
+# module name and returns a LOADED, runnable module — the entire path is Rian.
+#
+#     build(src, modname) = load(compile_forms(compile_module(src, modname)), modname)
+#
+# The only host dependency is the two irreducible BEAM toolchain calls, declared
+# as `@external(:ex, …)` FFI (ADR-0068) and COUNTED in @selfhost_ffi:
+#   * `:compile.forms`     — abstract forms -> a {:ok, Mod, Binary} object
+#   * `:code.load_binary`  — load that binary into the running VM
+# Everything between them — destructuring the `{:ok, _, _}` result, threading the
+# binary, returning the module atom — is ordinary Rian. This is the BEAM-bootstrap
+# terminus shape (ADR-0063 §4): feed `build` a slice of the compiler's own source
+# and the loop closes. (The portable terminus — compiling the compiler to Rust/JS
+# — is separate and further; these `@external(:ex)` calls pin the driver to `:ex`.)
+#
+# `test/rian/compose_driver_fixpoint_test.exs` calls ONLY `build` and runs the
+# returned module — no Elixir compile/load anywhere. Identical to `Rian.Beam`.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeDriver do
+  # ── shared pipeline types ──
+  type Tok := TNum(String) | TId(String) | TOp(String) | TLP | TRP | TComma | TDef
+  type Pat := PLit(String) | PVar(String)
+
+  type Surface := SNum(String)
+                | SId(String)
+                | SBin(String, Surface, Surface)
+                | SCall(String, Vec(Surface))
+
+  type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CId(String)
+             | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+
+  type Decl := Def(String, Vec(Pat), Surface)
+  type Grp := Grp(String, Int53, Vec(Decl))
+
+  type ErlForm := Integer(Int53, Int53)
+                | Var(Int53, Symbol)
+                | Atom(Int53, Symbol)
+                | Op(Int53, Symbol, ErlForm, ErlForm)
+                | Call(Int53, ErlForm, Vec(ErlForm))
+
+  # ── the BEAM toolchain boundary: two @external(:ex) host calls (counted FFI) ──
+  # `:compile.forms` turns the abstract-form list into a {:ok, Mod, Binary} object;
+  # `:code.load_binary` loads that binary into the VM. These pin the driver to :ex.
+  @external(:ex, ":compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])")
+  def compile_forms(forms Vec(Tuple)) Tuple
+
+  @external(:ex, ":code.load_binary(name, chars, bin)")
+  def load_binary(name Symbol, chars Vec(Int53), bin String) Tuple
+
+  # ── the driver: source -> a loaded, runnable module (the whole loop, in Rian) ──
+  pub def build(src String, modname Symbol) Symbol
+  pub def build(src, modname)
+    case compile_forms(compile_module(src, modname)) do
+      {:ok, m, bin} -> loaded(load_binary(m, Prim.str_chars("nofile"), bin))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def loaded(Tuple) Symbol
+  def loaded({:module, m}) := m
+
+  # ── source -> a full :compile.forms input (the rung-4 whole-module compiler) ──
+  pub def compile_module(src String, modname Symbol) Vec(Tuple)
+  pub def compile_module(src, modname) := assemble(modname, group(parse_clauses(lex(src))))
+
+  # ── stage 1: lex (String -> tokens) ──
+  pub def lex(s String) Vec(Tok) := lex_chars(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def lex_chars(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_chars([]) := []
+  def lex_chars([c | rest])
+    if c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 do
+      lex_chars(rest)
+    else
+      classify(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def classify(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def classify(c, rest)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    if is_alpha(c) do
+      take_id([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      take_op([c | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_num(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_num([], acc) := [TNum(text(acc))]
+  def take_num([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TNum(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_id(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_id([], acc) := [id_tok(text(acc))]
+  def take_id([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_alnum(c) do
+      take_id(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [id_tok(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def id_tok(String) Tok
+  def id_tok("def") := TDef
+  def id_tok(s) := TId(s)
+
+  def take_op(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_op([58, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(":=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([44 | rest]) := [TComma | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([40 | rest]) := [TLP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([41 | rest]) := [TRP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([c | rest]) := [TOp(Prim.str_from_chars([c])) | lex_chars(rest)]
+
+  def text(acc Vec(Int53)) String := Prim.str_from_chars(rev_codes(acc, []))
+
+  def rev_codes(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev_codes([], out) := out
+  def rev_codes([c | rest], out) := rev_codes(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def is_alpha(c Int53) Bool := (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or c == 95
+  def is_alnum(c Int53) Bool := is_alpha(c) or is_digit(c)
+
+  # ── stage 2a: parse the clause sequence ──
+  type CR := CR(Decl, Vec(Tok))
+
+  pub def parse_clauses(Vec(Tok)) Vec(Decl)
+  pub def parse_clauses([]) := []
+  pub def parse_clauses(ts)
+    case parse_one(ts) do
+      CR(d, rest) -> [d | parse_clauses(rest)]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_one(Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_one([_ | rest])
+    case rest do
+      [TId(name) | r2] -> parse_head(name, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_head(name String, Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_head(name, [TLP | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [], rest)
+
+  def collect_pats(name String, acc Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := finish_clause(name, rev_pats(acc, []), rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := collect_pats(name, acc, rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TNum(n) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PLit(n) | acc], rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TId(p) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PVar(p) | acc], rest)
+
+  def finish_clause(name String, pats Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def finish_clause(name, pats, [_ | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(body, leftover) -> CR(Def(name, pats, body), leftover)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_pats(Vec(Pat), Vec(Pat)) Vec(Pat)
+  def rev_pats([], out) := out
+  def rev_pats([p | rest], out) := rev_pats(rest, [p | out])
+
+  # ── stage 2b: parse a body expression (precedence climbing, with calls) ──
+  type PR := PR(Surface, Vec(Tok))
+
+  def parse_bp(min_bp Int53, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_bp(min_bp, ts)
+    case primary(ts) do
+      PR(lhs, rest) -> climb(min_bp, lhs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def climb(min_bp Int53, lhs Surface, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    if lbp(op) >= min_bp do
+      case parse_bp(rbp(op), rest) do
+        PR(rhs, rest2) -> climb(min_bp, SBin(op, lhs, rhs), rest2)
+      end
+    else
+      PR(lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    end
+  end
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, ts) := PR(lhs, ts)
+
+  def primary(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def primary([TNum(n) | rest]) := PR(SNum(n), rest)
+  def primary([TId(x) | rest]) := call_or_var(x, rest)
+  def primary([TLP | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(e, [TRP | rest2]) -> PR(e, rest2)
+      PR(e, other) -> PR(e, other)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def call_or_var(name String, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def call_or_var(name, [TLP | rest]) := parse_args(name, [], rest)
+  def call_or_var(name, ts) := PR(SId(name), ts)
+
+  def parse_args(name String, acc Vec(Surface), Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := PR(SCall(name, rev_surf(acc, [])), rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := parse_args(name, acc, rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(arg, rest) -> parse_args(name, [arg | acc], rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_surf(Vec(Surface), Vec(Surface)) Vec(Surface)
+  def rev_surf([], out) := out
+  def rev_surf([e | rest], out) := rev_surf(rest, [e | out])
+
+  def lbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op))
+  def rbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op)) + 1
+  def bp_base(lvl Int53) Int53 := (13 - lvl) * 10
+
+  def level(String) Int53
+  def level("*") := 3
+  def level("+") := 4
+  def level("-") := 4
+
+  # ── stage 2c: group consecutive clauses into per-function groups ──
+  def group(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group([]) := []
+  def group([Def(name, pats, body) | rest]) := group_run(name, plen(pats), [Def(name, pats, body)], rest)
+
+  def group_run(name String, arity Int53, acc Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, []) := [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, []))]
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])
+    if name == n2 do
+      group_run(name, arity, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | acc], rest)
+    else
+      [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, [])) | group([Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_decls(Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Decl)
+  def rev_decls([], out) := out
+  def rev_decls([d | rest], out) := rev_decls(rest, [d | out])
+
+  # ── stage 3: lower (Surface -> Core) ──
+  pub def lower(Surface) Core
+  pub def lower(SNum(t)) := CNum(t)
+  pub def lower(SId(n)) := CId(n)
+  pub def lower(SBin(op, l, r)) := CBin(op, lower(l), lower(r))
+  pub def lower(SCall(f, args)) := CCall(f, lower_all(args))
+
+  def lower_all(Vec(Surface)) Vec(Core)
+  def lower_all([]) := []
+  def lower_all([e | rest]) := [lower(e) | lower_all(rest)]
+
+  # ── stage 4: assemble the whole module form list (native Rian tuples) ──
+  def assemble(modname Symbol, groups Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple) := [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports(groups)} | func_forms(groups)]
+
+  def exports(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def exports([]) := []
+  def exports([Grp(name, arity, _) | rest]) := [{Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity} | exports(rest)]
+
+  def func_forms(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def func_forms([]) := []
+  def func_forms([Grp(name, arity, decls) | rest]) := [{:function, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity, clauses(decls)} | func_forms(rest)]
+
+  def clauses(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def clauses([]) := []
+  def clauses([Def(_, pats, body) | rest]) := [{:clause, 0, pat_forms(pats), [], [forms(lower(body))]} | clauses(rest)]
+
+  def pat_forms(Vec(Pat)) Vec(ErlForm)
+  def pat_forms([]) := []
+  def pat_forms([p | rest]) := [pat_form(p) | pat_forms(rest)]
+
+  def pat_form(Pat) ErlForm
+  def pat_form(PLit(n)) := Integer(0, parse_int(n))
+  def pat_form(PVar(p)) := Var(0, Prim.str_to_atom(cap(p)))
+
+  def plen(Vec(Pat)) Int53
+  def plen([]) := 0
+  def plen([_ | rest]) := 1 + plen(rest)
+
+  def forms(Core) ErlForm
+  def forms(CNum(t)) := Integer(0, parse_int(t))
+  def forms(CId(n)) := Var(0, Prim.str_to_atom(cap(n)))
+  def forms(CBin(op, l, r)) := Op(0, op_atom(op), forms(l), forms(r))
+  def forms(CCall(f, args)) := Call(0, Atom(0, Prim.str_to_atom(f)), forms_all(args))
+
+  def forms_all(Vec(Core)) Vec(ErlForm)
+  def forms_all([]) := []
+  def forms_all([e | rest]) := [forms(e) | forms_all(rest)]
+
+  def op_atom(String) Symbol
+  def op_atom("+") := :"+"
+  def op_atom("-") := :"-"
+  def op_atom("*") := :"*"
+
+  def parse_int(s String) Int53 := digits(Prim.str_chars(s), 0)
+  def digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def digits([], acc) := acc
+  def digits([c | rest], acc) := digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+
+  def cap(s String) String
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | rest] -> Prim.str_from_chars([up(c) | rest])
+      [] -> s
+    end
+  end
+
+  def up(c Int53) Int53
+    if c >= 97 and c <= 122 do
+      c - 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+end

+  # source string -> a loaded, runnable module:
+  #
+  #     build(src, modname) = load(compile_forms(compile_module(src, modname)), modname)
+  #
+  # The only host dependency is the two irreducible BEAM toolchain calls, declared as
+  # `@external(:ex, …)` FFI and counted in @selfhost_ffi: `:compile.forms` and
+  # `:code.load_binary`. Everything between — destructuring `{:ok, _, _}`, threading
+  # the binary, returning the module atom — is ordinary Rian.
+  #
+  # Unlike rungs 1-4, this test calls NOTHING but `build`: no Elixir `:compile.forms`,
+  # no `:code.load_binary`. The Rian driver compiles AND loads; the test merely runs
+  # the returned module and asserts it behaves identically to `Rian.Beam`.

+    {:ok, drv: drv}
+  end

+    m
+  end

+  @corpus [

+      "def square(n Int53) Int53 := n * n\ndef sumsq(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := square(a) + square(b)",
+      [{:square, [9]}, {:sumsq, [3, 4]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)\ndef fib2(n) := fib(n) + fib(n)",
